text:
rohan: Postmortem summary (INC-4822) — two rollouts overlapped KV priming and violated blast-radius assumptions. We need a compact checklist + owners.

nadia: propose 4 immediate fixes: 1) deployment blackout window enforcement, 2) rollout-cohort kv-miss telemetry, 3) blast_radius cap + schema change, 4) lightweight auto-rollback rule.

cam: i'll own auto-rollback prototype. rule: sustained error delta >=2% OR p95+200ms for 4m => revert to last-good variant and page. Demo in 48h. Default ON for self-serve, OFF for Dedicated.

zara: i'll add schema validation for `blast_radius_limit` with default 3 for new flags, 5 for legacy. PR in 4d.

rohan: i'll add a CI lint that forbids rollout schedules overlapping entries in `infra/jobs/priming_windows.yaml`. nadia take telemetry?

nadia: yes — adding cohort label to metrics pipeline and a weekly report that flags rollouts with avg_kv_miss > 8% or err spikes. 3d ETA.

ops-bot: created INF-1160 "rollout-guardrails" assigned to cam + zara + nadia. CI job `rollout-safety-check` scheduled.

cam: after prototype let's run a 7-day shadow on staging with priming spikes replayed. owner: ops-sre. due: 2 weeks.

rohan: summary of follow-ups (owner, due): (auto-rollback prototype: cam, +2d), (blast_radius schema + validation: zara, +4d), (cohort telemetry + report: nadia, +3d), (CI blackout lint: rohan, Tue EOD), (shadow run: ops-sre, +14d). I'll update the postmortem tracker and set reminders.

zara: posting PR links here when ready.

cam: ack.

nadi a: ack.
